john.16.p1.b1.text: “I have told you these things so that you will not fall away.

john.16.p1.b2.text: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.

john.16.p1.b3.text: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them.

john.16.p2.b1.text: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’

john.16.p2.b2.text: Instead, your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things.

john.16.p2.b3.text: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.

john.16.p3.b1.text: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:

john.16.p3.b2.text: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;

john.16.p3.b3.text: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.

john.16.p4.b1.text: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.

john.16.p4.b2.text: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth.

john.16.p4.b3.text: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.

john.16.p5.b1.text: In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me.”

john.16.p5.b2.text: Why is He saying, ‘a little while’? We do not understand what He is saying.

john.16.p5.b3.text: Aware that they wanted to question Him,

john.16.p5.b4.text: … Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?

john.16.p6.b1.text: … You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

john.16.p6.b2.text: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come;

john.16.p6.b3.text: but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.

john.16.p6.b4.text: … but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.

john.16.p7.b1.text: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything.

john.16.p7.b2.text: … whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

john.16.p7.b3.text: … Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.

john.16.p8.b1.text: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will … tell you plainly about the Father.

john.16.p8.b2.text: In that day you will ask in My name. … For the Father Himself loves you,

john.16.p8.b3.text: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”

john.16.p9.b1.text: See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech. … Because of this, we believe that You came from God.

john.16.p9.b3.text: Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone.

john.16.p9.b4.text: Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.

john.16.p10.b1.text: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace.

john.16.p10.b2.text: In the world you will have tribulation.

john.16.p10.b3.text: But take courage; I have overcome the world!
